finding.headline: "The Breastfeeding Snack Station"
finding.problem: "I'm stuck on the couch for hours nursing. If there's no snack next to me, I just don't eat and then I'm rage-y and starving at midnight."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"
finding.person: Same mama; needs a curl-up-side caddy of grab-and-go nourishing snacks (energy bites, roasted nuts, fruit, lactation cookies) so feeding time = eating time.
